filename: Toward a Taxonomy of Trust for Probabilistic Machine Learning.pdf
title: Toward a Taxonomy of Trust for Probabilistic Machine Learning
code_availability: Stan and R code mentioned; election forecasting code and data hosted on GitHub.
testbed_rationale: The paper presents a conceptual framework/taxonomy of trust for probabilistic machine learning and case studies in economics and political science; it does not contain Earth/climate system models or datasets.
pain_points: Gap between real-world goals and training-data formulations
Statistical model misspecification and fragility of modeling assumptions
Algorithmic approximation errors (finite-time MCMC mixing, variational Bayes KL gap)
Implementation bugs in complex analysis and pre-processing pipelines
Sensitivity of conclusions to small subsets of training data
extraction_notes: The document is a general perspective/framework paper on trust, reproducibility, and robustness in probabilistic machine learning, with application case studies in microcredit economics and US presidential election forecasting.
